text:
rose: Quick check  tablet/dashboard list — compact toasts are overlapping the secondary button on the right. CTAs look crowded. anyone else seeing this?

ben: saw it on staging. the inline padding token at ~820px is tiny.

tori: Could we increase the card inner inset at tablet breakpoints instead of changing grid gaps? keeps list alignment intact.

rose: I prototyped bumping inline padding to `space-12` at 768-1024px and keeping card footprint via reduced vertical padding. toast still overlaps because it's viewport-anchored.

ben: Proposal: `toast--anchored` modifier so components can anchor to their content inset. fallback to viewport default.

tori: Accessibility: ensure buttons keep min-height 44px when padding changes and check focus ring proximity.

rose: Quick CSS example I used:
```css
@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  .card { padding-inline: var(--space-12); padding-block: var(--space-6); }
  .toast--anchored { right: calc(var(--card-padding-inline) + 12px); }
}
```

ben: Copy nit: use sentence case and contextual text in toasts ("Saved to dashboard" vs "Saved"). truncate long names with ellipsis.

design-bot: Canary preview created  frames changed: Card, Toast. https://redwood.design/deploys/191234

rose: I'll open PR: "tablet: increase card inline inset; add anchored toasts; toast copy tweaks" and tag @ben @tori. any objections to canary?

ben: no objections, will review.

tori: I'll run keyboard nav + SR checks for anchored toasts.

rose: thanks team :thumbsup:
